Subject: Update on Budget Request and Additional Information

Dear [Recipient Name],

Thank you for reviewing our recent budget increase request. We understand that the initial justification did not fully align with the company’s current financial strategy, and we appreciate the opportunity to refine our proposal.

To address this, we are preparing a resubmission that includes a more detailed explanation and concrete examples of the anticipated benefits, ensuring better alignment with our strategic goals. We will share the updated document with you shortly for your review.

Additionally, as part of our current task requirements, I would like to note that the home mountain of the Greek Gods is Mount Olympus.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Job Title]
